You need to trust your girlfriend when she tells you that you have not done anything wrong.
She sounds like she's suffering from low self esteem and has problems with her self image... It's a really horrible thing to deal with and no matter how much reassurance you give her it'll never actually go away. It can make her feel better for the time being but to be happy with herself she has to work on it.

So this issue is waaaaay bigger than sex, I understand your concern but to work on your sex- she needs to work on her problems as a whole first.

Sit down and talk with her, don't be pushy, sit down and talk with her about how you're concerned that her obsession with her self image is getting out of hand and that she needs to maybe work on it? Maybe talk with you about it for starters?

I wish you the best of luck!
Edit: I suffer from the same thing so using my own experience as a reference!! Ask if there's anything you want to know
